author: NingMeng123
status: Specification and acceptance criteria; execution results are recorded separately

source_candidate_selection.selection_order: Select the nearest legal visible vulnerable player first, then evaluate tg.f only for that candidate
source_candidate_selection.source_distance_origin: Attacker x, feetY + height/2, z to player position

source_trigger_order.rule: A decoy returns false without RNG
Always consume nextInt(3); if zero and endermenEnemy curse exists, return true without setting bt=5
Selected mainhand pearl or eye plays stare sound, sets bt=5 and returns true without an inventory random draw
Add pearl and eye getNumItems using signed Java int arithmetic; if N>0 consume nextInt(2000), and on draw<N play stare sound, set bt=5 and return true
Only then check pumpkin and ordinary player gaze/visibility

source_inventory.count_arithmetic: Signed int32 addition per type and another int32 addition across the two types; no explicit clamp or overflow protection

inventory_probability.unit: Per eligible selected-candidate evaluation, not per second
inventory_probability.source_search_cadence: Unoccupied Enderman searches on each old-AI update; other old-AI mobs have the 10-tick gate
inventory_probability.modern_search_cadence: Retain native goal scheduling; no promised fixed wall-clock trigger interval
inventory_probability.manual_test_limit: Use normal stacks and inventory capacity; the mathematical N>=2000 boundary is an automated rule fixture, not a required oversized-stack gameplay test

source_activation.source_sound: mob.endermen.stare at the player, volume 1, pitch 1

modern_adaptations.count_api: Inventory.countItem for each of the two item IDs, then signed int sum
modern_adaptations.range_and_stealth: Retain native TargetingConditions, LivingEntity visibility and NeoForge visibility hooks; includes modern distance origin, adjusted visibility-range boundary and minimum effective range of 2
modern_adaptations.sound: Retain native stared-at/creepy state synchronization and client feedback; do not also play the old player-position stare sound
modern_adaptations.ordinary_gaze_cadence: Retain modern native behavior; not a full migration of old on/tg AI
modern_adaptations.already_targeting_gaze_freeze_and_telepo: Retain native behavior; do not repeatedly run inventory-trigger RNG here
modern_adaptations.pursuit_and_anger: Retain native modern target continuation and anger lifecycle
modern_adaptations.old_path_reselection_not_migrated: on.java:134,197-210 can replace or clear an existing target on old path refresh/completion; no direct surrender-items cancellation existed

confirmed: tg.f consumes the curse roll before held checks
Inventory RNG is conditional on N>0
Held and inventory success set bt=5
The postincrement compares the previous bt to 5 in the same findPlayerToAttack call
Outer candidate filtering requires sensing LOS
Old path refresh can reassign current target

acceptance: Mainhand pearl and eye immediately acquire a legal visible player without player stare, even while the player wears a pumpkin
Offhand held items behave immediately as an explicitly documented modern extension
Count the two item quantities together once across the intended inventory slots
Draw=N-1 succeeds, draw=N fails; N<=0 skips inventory RNG; N>=2000 still consumes a draw
Preserve the curse roll before held/count branches and keep curse-success acquisition noninstant
No aggression RNG for out-of-range, illegal or wall-occluded candidates
Evaluate only the nearest legal visible candidate, including a closer noncarrier
Cursor, crafting, external containers and nested contents do not contribute
Existing pursuit does not clear just because the player removes items
Keep native ordinary gaze, freeze, teleport and anger behavior
